# F&S VENTURES LLC

> F&S VENTURES LLC is a Delaware limited liability company based in Minnetonka, Minnesota. It builds and operates small, focused software products for businesses, each aimed at one specific, recurring problem.

## Products

- [LedgerMedic](https://ledgermedic.com): Finds and fixes costly QuickBooks Online errors, such as stuck Undeposited Funds and customer payments counted twice.
- [Sprinklerly](https://sprinklerly.com): Operations software for irrigation and sprinkler contractors: scheduling, dispatch, routes, work orders and backflow compliance.
- [GrantClose](https://grantclose.com): Post-award grant tracking for small nonprofits: every reporting deadline with an owner, the evidence beside it, and a closeout packet at the end.
- [GigDriverProfit](https://gigdriverprofit.com): Shows Android gig-delivery drivers the true profit per hour of each offer the moment it arrives.
- [SPCC Plan Builder](https://spccbuilder.com): Tells small facilities whether the EPA's SPCC rule applies to them, then builds a self-certified Tier I plan with review reminders.
- [Condo Records Portal](https://condorecordsportal.com): An official-records portal for Florida condo associations, with the posting checklist and request deadlines the statute requires.
